Workflow.Name: VET-HOME - Portal Message - Assign Owner to Incoming Portal Message
Workflow.Description: Assign owner of the incoming portal message from VA to the team of original message sent by Dynamics User. If it is provider team, assign owner to the provider instead of provider team.
